definitions.explanation: The state of being completely still or stationary, without any movement. Used in both everyday and scientific/technical contexts.

examples.japanese: {静止|せいし}した{状態|じょうたい}を{保|たも}つ。
カメラの{前|まえ}で{数秒間|すうびょうかん}{静止|せいし}してください。
examples.english: Please stand still for a few seconds in front of the camera.

examples.japanese: {静止|せいし}{衛星|えいせい}は{地球|ちきゅう}の{自転|じてん}と{同|おな}じ{速度|そくど}で{回|まわ}っているため、{空|そら}の{同|おな}じ{位置|いち}に{見|み}える。
examples.english: A geostationary satellite orbits at the same speed as the Earth's rotation, so it appears at the same position in the sky.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
{静止|せいし}する is used as a する verb meaning "to stand still, to remain motionless."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {静止|せいし}{画像|がぞう} (still image)
- {静止|せいし}{衛星|えいせい} (geostationary satellite)
- {静止|せいし}{状態|じょうたい} (stationary state)
- {静止|せいし}{画|が} (still frame, still picture)
